description: Run the off-site backup immediately and report what was uploaded. Use this to PROVE a new configuration works instead of waiting for the nightly run to fail quietly — it exercises the real credentials, the real bucket and the real upload path, and records the result in last_run / last_error exactly as the scheduled job does. Works whether or not the schedule is enabled, so a configuration can be verified before turning it on. Uploads a verified backup set: the database, .env, icons, per-app /data and volumes, managed-database dumps and every managed-app git repository, plus a SHA-256 manifest (`key` is the manifest key, `size` the total bytes of the set). PLATFORM ADMIN ONLY.
name: appcrane_run_backup_now
